interpretation.secondary: Slow min-speed .005 diagnostic on the same parents, never pooled with primary
interpretation.uncertainty_unit: Native independent parent; synthetic whole field; derivatives remain clustered
interpretation.resolved_geometry: Independent truth span >=3 pixels; native requires >=3 finite centers. Candidate rows preserved, other truths do not count. Diagnostic only.
interpretation.all_planned: Includes unresolved and ambiguous/preexisting-match trials; common-attributable separately excludes shared attribution failures
interpretation.scores: Uncalibrated ranking scores, not real-object probabilities
interpretation.native_precision: UNKNOWN: real control identities remain unlabelled; no real precision estimate
interpretation.caps: Cap flags are separate search-coverage limits; zero runtime failures does not imply uncapped search
interpretation.runtime: Per-worker stage sums and peak RSS; reused detector work can appear in both systems. Not service latency.
